summary:
I have found the issue and resolved the circular import cycle that was causing the crash on startup. 

The issue occurred because `users.py` imported `NotificationService` from `notifications.py` *before* `DEFAULT_ROLE` was defined, while `notifications.py` attempted to access `users.DEFAULT_ROLE` at the module level when evaluating. By moving `DEFAULT_ROLE = "member"` to be above the `notifications` import in `users.py`, the attribute exists on the module when `notifications.py` tries to access it.

I've executed `test.sh` and confirmed all tests now pass successfully.
